name: school-app-mobile
description: Store app (Android + iOS) for the school platform — wraps the mobile build of ../app with Capacitor

scripts.web: cd ../app && npm ci && npm run build:mobile
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
